en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
I might fall asleep...
Play dominoes with the movie boxes
We should focus on reality, not movies

Well, sure. If you grab some 
boring movie or something.

But if you decide that's gonna happen 
from the start, then it probably will.

If you always expect the worst, 
then you'll always get the worst!

I may not seem like it, but I'm pretty 
good at setting up dominoes!

During astronaut training, 
we had to do dexterity exercises.

I, Kaito Momota, Luminary of the Stars, will 
make a domino setup that will shock even you!
Right on! That's my sidekick!

A man should chase real passions, 
not sit around watching fake stuff!

Hell yeah!
I'm fired up like crazy now!

I'll teach you all about the universe 
as I imagine it!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaito looks deep in thought...
(Damn it...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kaito's inner thoughts...?
